item.title: Nearly time to sign up for garden waste collection by SKDC
item.description: Residents will soon have the chance to sign up for the popular garden waste recycling scheme offered by South Kesteven District Council. item.title: A dangerous driver on Dysart Road sentenced at Lincoln Crown Court
item.description: Driving without shoes and only socks on his feet, Christopher Bill failed to stop for police and drove so dangerously his passenger called her boyfriend in tears. item.title: Sweets provided to children at Stathern, near Belvoir, were laced with sedatives
item.description: Today John Ruben pleaded guilty at Leicester Crown Court to a charge of administering a poison/noxious substance with intent in July 2025. This charge relates to an adult victim. Ruben has previously pleaded guilty to 17 offences.
